name: dcr
description: Build internal tools inside Django Admin with Django Control Room: support consoles, billing and ops pages, approval workflows, and dashboards. Agent skills to set up DCR and to create, package, or extend its tools (panels).

com.openai.interface.shortDescription: Build internal tools in Django Admin
com.openai.interface.longDescription: Build internal tools inside Django Admin with a coding agent: customer support lookups, billing and operations consoles, staff approval workflows, and operational dashboards. The skills use Django Control Room (DCR), a plugin framework for the Django admin, where each tool is a panel. They install and verify DCR in an existing Django project, create a staff-only tool inside the project or a reusable tool packaged for PyPI from the official Cookiecutter, and extend existing tools (pages, actions, settings, permission scopes, MCP tools for AI agents) without breaking existing scopes, URL names, tool names, or settings keys. They leave ordinary ModelAdmin changes, public-facing pages, hosting, and deployments alone.
defaultPrompt: Build a tool for support to look up a customer and their recent orders.
Add a staff approval queue for refund requests.
Add a retry button to the webhook failures page.
